'''D2-0A''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]], it was used by the [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]] to send a covert message to [[Cipher Nine]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
D2-0A appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in hologram during the Imperial Agent class quest on Rishi.
